name: Agathion, Guloval
body:
GULOVAL
CR 12

This small humanoid creature with reddish fur and little glittering eyes seems as if it is ready to attack at any moment, but nonetheless its demeanor feels somehow grudgingly friendly.

XP 19,200
NG Small outsider (agathion, extraplanar, good)
Init +7; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +27

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 15, flat-footed 23 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +12 natural, +1 size)
hp 152 (16d10+64); regeneration 2 (evil weapons and spells)
Fort +14, Ref +8, Will +16; +4 vs. poison; DR 10/evil and silver; Immune electricity, petrification; Resist cold 10, sonic 10

OFFENSE

Speed 25 feet, burrow 20 feet
Melee bite +18 (1d4+16), 2 claws +18 (1d3+16)
Special Attacks blood rage, righteous wound
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 16th; concentration +18)

Constant–speak with animals
At will–magic circle against evil, remove curse, remove disease, remove fear, shield other
3/day-flash forward, holy smite (DC 16), righteous might

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 17, Con 19, Int 17, Will 18, Cha 15
Base Atk +16; CMB +21; CMD 34
Feats Alertness, Bodyguard, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, In Harm’s Way, Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +19, Climb +25, Intimidate +21, Knowledge (nature) +22, Knowledge (planes) +22, Perception +27, Sense Motive +27, Stealth +22, Survival +23
Languages Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; speak with animals, truespeech
SQ lay on hands (8d6, 10/day, as a 16th level paladin), wolverine’s protection

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Righteous Wound (Sp)

A guloval’s natural weapons are treated as adamantine for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness, and have the ominous weapon property against evil opponents.

Wolverine’s Protection (Sp)

A guloval can designate up to 4 creatures as its wards. It cannot select a creature already designated by another guloval. The guloval gains a permanent status effect with each one of its wards. A guloval can change one of its designated wards with 1 hour of meditation.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land (Nirvana)
Organization solitary, pair, or mob (2–6)
Treasure standard

Shorter and fiercer relatives of mustelidals, gulovals are most often formed from the souls of good-aligned barbarians. They are unrelenting fighters and may fly in a blood frenzy if provoked, but their driving force is protecting the creatures they chose as their “pack members”. A guloval is loyal to its friends and companions till it or (more probably) its enemies die.
